title: select_credentials action params
description: The params of a wmp.flow.action with action select_credentials in an oid4vp flow (wmp-openid4x Section 3.2.3.1). An orchestrator selects this schema by the action of a flow it recorded as oid4vp, never by members of the params. A closed set: nothing but consent and selections can be present, and a selection is only a query id and the opaque handle, so no credential id, claim name or value, disclosure, vct, format, issuer or free text can ride along. That each query_id is an id in the verifier's request (a DCQL credential query id, or an input descriptor id), that none is repeated, that every selection_handle is the same, and that it equals the handle of the match result when that carried one are checked by the orchestrator, which holds the request and the result.
